{{Recipe}}

'''Wara''' refers to Nigerian cheese curds or tofu, the former being made from cow milk and the latter from soy milk. It is sometimes eaten as a snack by travelers, who can always get it as a staple product. The recipe below is for fried cow milk wara.

== Ingredients ==
* Cow [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* [[Cookbook:Lime|Lime]] juice
* [[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]], for frying

== Procedure ==
# [[Cookbook:Straining|Strain]] the milk into a large pot.
# Bring the milk to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] over medium heat, stirring frequently.
# Reduce the heat, and add lime juice. Do not stir. The curds should separate from the whey.
# Pack the curds in a [[Cookbook:Colander|colander]], and allow excess water to drain out.
# Cut curds into desired shapes, and [[Cookbook:Deep Fat Frying|deep fry]] in hot oil.
